### God’s Regard for the King of Judah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Reformed Bible Studies & Devotionals at Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-regard-for-king-of-judah
Passage: 2 Kings 3:14
Points:
- King Jehoram of Israel enlisted King Jehoshaphat of Judah to help suppress Moab’s revolt.
- Facing dehydration and defeat in the desert, the allied kings turned to the prophet Elisha.
- Elisha agreed to consult the Lord only out of respect for righteous Jehoshaphat.
- God miraculously provided water and gave the coalition victory over the Moabites.
- Unworthy sinners receive God’s favor solely through the righteousness of Jesus Christ, the true King.

### Humbly Receive from Him
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-may-16-2018.html
Passage: 2 Kings 3:16-17
Points:
- Dire thirst in the wilderness exposed human helplessness and directed the army to God.
- God commanded the people to demonstrate faith by digging ditches before seeing any rain.
- The Lord provided water in an unexpected and quiet way according to His sovereign plan.
- Divine provision was more than abundant enough to satisfy the needs of all.
- Believers are challenged to actively prepare in faith for the blessings God desires to give.
